failure_mode: length prefix disagrees with the message type
detail: The prefix declares 40 bytes and 40 bytes are present, so the read itself succeeds - but type 'A' (Add Order, no MPID) is defined as 36 bytes; 40 is the length of 'F'. This is framing desync, and unlike an unknown type it is NOT recoverable by skipping: the stream position can no longer be trusted. Must raise and report BOTH the prefix (40) and the expected length for 'A' (36).
